note: PORTAL paper (Xu et al. 2025) abstract: LLMs generate 'behavior trees represented in domain-specific language (DSL)', hybrid rule+neural nodes, validated across thousands of FPS games; policies 'instantaneously deployable, human-interpretable'.
PORTAL project page: BT generator emits DSL/JSON per policy 'which can be parsed to run the corresponding behavior tree in the game'; dual-feedback policy iteration without RL.

LLM-BT (Zhou, Lin, Yan, Min, Zhu, 2024): ChatGPT reasoning + BERT parser + action template library; in-tree Expand/Insert recovery; cargo sorting ~85% (18/20 etc. per case), household ~75%, 5 cases x 20 users; XML semantic map; simulated validation.

LLM-as-BT-Planner (Ao, Wu, Wu, Swikir, Haddadin; TUM/MIRMI+MBZUAI): four ICL methods; GPT-4 17 tasks one-step 12/17, iterative 12/17 (7,770 tokens), human-in-loop 16/17, recursive 13/17 (50,230 tokens); fine-tuned Mistral-7B executability 7/10 -> 10/10; PyTrees execution.

BTGenBot (Izzo, Bardaro, Matteucci; PoliMi 2024): <=7B LLMs generate XML behavior trees for BehaviorTree.CPP; syntactic correctness up to 100% base one-shot, 86-88.9% fine-tuned; execution 7/9 tasks with one-shot + static analysis; failure causes are parameter-format mismatches.

VLM-driven BT (Wake, Kanehira, Takamatsu, Sasabuchi, Ikeuchi; Microsoft 2025): GPT-4o emits JSON compiled to BT; conversational full-regeneration editing; 10/10 valid BT generation, 8/10 end-to-end success on SEED-noid.

LLM-based BT generation for construction machinery (Tsutsumi et al., Kyushu Univ., 2026): LLM plan -> XML BTs run by fixed BehaviorTree.CPP scheduler; GPT-5 4/4 scenarios, small open models fail synchronization-heavy ones; real ZX200 excavator + dump truck validation.
Cao & Lee (AAAI-MAKE 2023) abstract page: founding LLM->BT paper; Phase-Step prompt design; BT-embedding-based search; verified title/authors (not 'PORTAL/Park').

Cao & Lee full text: Phase-Step textual BT encoding parsed to 3-layer trees; USE-similarity verb matching (threshold 0.5) against robot capability list; source-tree retrieval by BT embedding; ablation numbers (structure ratio R, N_total, N_mate for davinci-003 and ChatGPT) but no success rates.

Iovino et al. 'A Survey of Behavior Trees in Robotics and AI' (2020): BTs' modularity+reactivity vs FSM n^2 transitions; 'BTs have been successfully used as a policy representation for both learning and planning approaches'; py_trees/BehaviorTree.CPP among libraries.

BehaviorTree.CPP docs: 'Trees are created at run-time, using an interpreted language (based on XML)'; logging infrastructure to 'visualize, record, replay and analyze state transitions'; used for game AI and robotics.

Chris Simpson (Game Developer, 2014): game-AI BT practice; Sequence/Selector/Decorator semantics; 'failure is no longer a critical full stop'; trees authored data-driven with editors; leaf actions take parameters from shared context.
